description: This file defines an Android activity class 'TextUndoActivity' that provides a simple user interface to demonstrate text editing capabilities, including undo functionality, with various text manipulations such as setting, appending, inserting text, and formatting credit card input with spaces every four digits.

classes.name: TextUndoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating text editing and input formatting, including undo management and credit card input formatting with spaces.

classes.name: CreditCardTextWatcher
classes.description: A private static class implementing TextWatcher to enhance the credit card input field by automatically inserting spaces every four digits and filtering input to only numbers.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds UI components, and sets up button click listeners and text change listeners for credit card formatting.
